chapters.label: Penalties in Dresden
chapters.text: Dresden, 2011. The USA and Brazil go to penalties. Brazil's Daiane steps up. Hope Solo takes her time... Daiane shoots. Solo dives to her right. Saved!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Solo stays calm and big. She watches how Daiane runs at the ball, then pushes off and punches it away.

chapters.label: Strong hands
chapters.text: Up close: strong hands send it wide. Then Ali Krieger scores, and the USA win five to three!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: Keepers: stay calm and big. Read the kicker's run and hips. Then dive, and push the ball away with strong hands.
